content: .{@-अयण@} ({@अयन@}) {%a.%} .²1 attached or devoted to, adhering to. .²2 depending on, subject to. .²3 intent on, solely devoted to or absorbed in (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); प्रभुर्धनपरायणः <ls>Bh. 2. 56</ls>; so मोह˚; अथ मोहपरायणा सती विवशा कामवधूर्विबोधिता <ls>Ku. 4. 1</ls>; अग्निहोत्र˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²4 connected with. .²5 being a protector (त्राता); अबर्हाश्चरणैर्हीनाः पूर्वेषां वः परायणाः <ls>Mb. 1. 230. 4</ls>. .²6 leading or conducive to. . ({@-णम्@}) .²1 the principal or highest object, chief aim, best or last resort; एतत् परायणम् <ls>Praśna. Up. 1. 10</ls>; तपसश्च परायणम् <ls>Rām. 1. 21. 10</ls>; <ls>Mb. 12. 179. 12</ls>. .²2 essence, sum. .²3 <ab>Ved.</ab> going away, departure, exit. .²4 firm devotion. .²5 a universal medicine, panacea. .²6 a religious order.
